hero_description: From seasonal storefronts to one-of-a-kind window art, we bring a little magic to everyday spaces — all painted by hand, just for you.
intro_description: We're two artists who believe ordinary spaces deserve extraordinary little moments. From neighborhood storefronts to special celebrations, we make hand-painted details that make people stop, look, and smile.
studio_story: Laurel Ann Studio started with two creative minds and a shared love for art. We're Leighann and Laurel — two artists who believe everyday spaces are better with a little imagination. Our goal is simple: bring more creativity into the modern world, one hand-painted project at a time.

faqs.question: How do I get a quote?
faqs.answer: Fill out our free quote request form with a few details about your project. Photos and inspiration are always helpful!

faqs.question: Do you create custom designs?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! Every project is personal, and we love hearing your creative ideas.

faqs.question: Where are you located?
faqs.answer: We're based in Canton, Georgia, and serve surrounding communities. Contact us about your location!

faqs.question: How much does window painting cost?
faqs.answer: Each project is unique. Pricing depends on size, design complexity, and project details. Reach out for a personalized quote.

faqs.question: Can I request a specific painting date?
faqs.answer: Of course! Include your preferred date in the request form. We'll confirm availability with you directly.

faqs.question: Do you offer seasonal designs?
faqs.answer: Yes! We paint for holidays, changing seasons, celebrations, and special occasions.

faqs.question: Do I need to pay online?
faqs.answer: No. Payment arrangements are discussed directly with the studio, with payment collected after the service as agreed.
